title: device request definitions
description: Shared definitions of the device request and response bodies (05-runner.md section 11).

failure_code.description: closed list of failure codes of device responses: timeout (flow or poll expired), busy (another request of this kind is active), credential_missing (e.g. no mailbox credential), code_invalid (authorization code refused), login_cli_failed, token_invalid (unexpected token format), upstream_error (GitHub/Anthropic/IMAP refused), upstream_unreachable, device_shutdown, token_refused (GitHub refused a stored token: revoked or unknown), scope_missing (a classic token without the repo scope), sso_required (an organisation requires SSO authorisation of the token), flow_unavailable (the asked GitHub device flow is not set up on the device, KOR-65)
